headline_seed: Irish government announces further fuel supports after protests
description_seed: The Irish government has announced further fuel supports for a number of sectors after nationwide protests in recent weeks.

what: Irish government announces further fuel supports after protests

clean_source_blocks.text: The Irish government has announced further fuel supports for a number of sectors after nationwide protests in recent weeks.
The Irish government has announced further fuel supports for some workers and businesses, after nationwide protests in recent weeks.

Before nationwide protests kicked off, excise duty had already been cut on petrol and diesel - but in recent weeks since the protests, there have been further cuts to diesel and petrol and a package of supports for farmers, hauliers and coach drivers has been promised.
In total, the Irish government has spent €755m (£654m) on fuel supports in recent months, including today's announcement as well as previous excise duty cuts.
